Then provide the estimated total payable amount. We need to get the list of all airports first. Then pick the first and last. Then compute flight cost. Then we need to estimate total payable amount. But what does "estimated total payable amount" refer to? Possibly the flight cost plus maybe insurance? The user didn't mention insurance. They just want the estimated total payable amount. That might be the flight cost. But maybe they want to include taxes? The function get_flight_cost returns the cost in USD. So we can use that as the estimated total payable amount. So we need to call get_all_airports first. Then parse the result to get the first and last airport codes. Then call get_flight_cost with travel_from=first, travel_to=last, travel_date=2024-10-31, travel_class=business. Then provide the cost. There's no other cost. So we can do that.

We need to call get_all_airports.
